focus_area: Frontend data layer — query hooks, websocket payload types + handler, cache invalidation, toast, shared tier metadata

cross_boundary_verification.query_key_consistency: Hook query key ["aiJobCriteria", jobId] (jobId = numeric job.id, JobCriteriaSection.tsx:31 passes job.id). Mutation onSuccess invalidates ["aiJobCriteria", variables.jobId] (number). Websocket handler invalidates ["aiJobCriteria", Number(payload.jobId)] (number). Backend broadcasts jobId = ai_job_criteria.job_id (integer). All three keys are the same numeric Job primary key — deep-equality match, no stale-UI-after-completion mismatch.
cross_boundary_verification.payload_type_vs_backend_broadcast: JobCriteriaExtractionCompletePayload (status/jobId/jobTitle/zeroCriteriaFailure/errorMessage?) matches extract_job_criteria_job.rb#broadcast_completion (lines 51-57) field-for-field. Backend builds literal camelCase symbol keys (jobId/jobTitle/zeroCriteriaFailure/errorMessage) with NO key transform on the WebSocket boundary — verified identical to the AI_SUMMARY_COMPLETE analog (generate_ai_job_application_summary_job.rb:68-72 -> AiSummaryCompletePayload). status is only ever 'succeeded'|'failed' (broadcast gated on status_succeeded? || status_failed?, line 49); zeroCriteriaFailure is always present (built unconditionally); errorMessage is conditionally added, matching the optional TS field.
cross_boundary_verification.serializer_vs_hook_response_type: AiJobCriteriaPayload (criteria/extractedAt/status/zeroCriteriaFailure) matches JobAiJobCriteriaSerializer (criteria/extracted_at/status/zero_criteria_failure) after apiGet's allKeysToCamel (api.ts:22) camelCases KEYS only. status union pending|in_progress|succeeded|failed|retrying exactly matches the AiJobCriteria enum (ai_job_criteria.rb:21-27); enum string values and tier values stay snake_case because allKeysToCamel does not transform string values. Nested criterion source_heading -> sourceHeading; tier values tier_1/tier_2/tier_3 preserved.
cross_boundary_verification.tier_metadata: JOB_CRITERIA_TIERS keys tier_1/tier_2/tier_3 (labels Core/Preferred/Bonus; icons check-circle/plus-circle/star) match the stored tier values written by extract_criteria.rb (tier_1/tier_2/tier_3) and the AiJobCriterion tier union. Complete 3-tier set, correct order, no off-by-one. Glossary copy honors copy rules ("count most/less toward the score", no em dashes, sentence case).
cross_boundary_verification.no_fabricated_fallback: useAiJobCriteria uses enabled: jobId != undefined (loose !=, disables for both null and undefined) with no || 0 / || [] fallback that would fire a bogus request. Matches the useAiJobApplicationSummary analog's enabled convention.
